subject.title: [Feature]: Add a secure way to pair dynamically autoscaled worked nodes in K8s

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Kubernetes ServiceAccount/TokenReview worker-auth mode that can bypass interactive node pairing, and what fail-closed namespace, service-account, audience, issuer, TLS/CA, replay, and revocation policy must it enforce?
rationale: The requested behavior is missing and useful, but the solution changes gateway auth, protocol, config, deployment guidance, and the node-pairing trust boundary; automation cannot safely choose that security policy.

options.title: Approve Narrow SA Trust Design
options.body: Define a fail-closed Kubernetes worker identity contract, then accept a focused implementation with config, protocol, docs, tests, and deployment proof.

options.title: Fold Into Distributed Runtime Auth
options.body: Keep this issue open but make a broader distributed-runtime milestone own worker registration and authentication before implementation.

options.title: Decline Core K8s Worker Auth
options.body: Close this direction only if maintainers decide Kubernetes-specific worker trust should stay outside OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow SA Trust Design
recommendation.body: Define a fail-closed Kubernetes worker identity contract, then accept a focused implementation with config, protocol, docs, tests, and deployment proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current review context on this exact issue plus recent gateway auth/pairing history.
